items.summary: In learning activities, students can rehearse presentations, receive feedback on their delivery, and practice again with targeted suggestions to improve clarity and confidence. #education GA date: December CY2026

items.title: Outlook: More visibility into usage for recoverable items storage
items.summary: You'll be able to see how much storage your recoverable items are using in Outlook. This gives you a clearer picture of your storage usage before you reach a limit. You can use this information to make more informed decisions about managing your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY202

items.title: Outlook: Expand or collapse all accounts at once
items.summary: You'll be able to expand or collapse all accounts at once in Outlook's folder pane. You won't need to expand or collapse each account individually. This makes it easier to navigate multiple accounts or keep your folder pane compact. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY2027

items.title: Outlook: Remember your online archive folder pane state
items.summary: Outlook will remember whether your online archive is expanded or collapsed when you return. Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows will each keep their own saved state. This saves you from repeatedly expanding or collapsing your archive as you navigate your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Keep folders expanded when you restart Outlook
items.summary: Outlook will remember which folders and shared mailboxes you have expanded or collapsed when you restart the app. You can pick up where you left off without opening the same folder branches again. This makes returning to your usual folders easier. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY2027

items.title: Outlook: Sort your subfolders from A to Z
items.summary: You'll be able to sort a folder's subfolders alphabetically from the parent folder. This makes it easier to find the folder you need without rearranging subfolders one by one. It's a simple way to keep long folder lists organized. #newoutlookforwindows GA date: February CY2027

items.title: Outlook: Keep folder sharing within your organization's policies
items.summary: Folder sharing in Outlook will respect your organization's restrictions for Default and Anonymous permissions. ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookWriter that allows attackers to read local files by supplying crafted image filenames to addImage. Attackers can inject ../ path segments into user-controlled image paths, causing addMedia to embed any file readable by the Node.js process under xl/media in the generated workbook.
